items.text: Among adults having day surgery, is prophylaxis below the protocol's recommendation for the patient's risk score, compared with matched prophylaxis, associated with rescue treatment for nausea or vomiting in recovery or delayed discharge because of it?
items.population: Adults having day surgery in the unit from January 2025 to June 2026
items.intervention: Under-prophylaxis relative to the risk-tailored protocol (exposure)
items.outcome: Rescue antiemetic in recovery or discharge delayed by nausea or vomiting

finer: Feasible within 60 hours of record reading and approval HR-2026-118; interesting to anaesthetists and recovery nurses; novel locally; ethical with a consent waiver request; relevant because nausea drives unplanned stays.
summary: One PECO question for the primary exposure.
